prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create a six-view PRODUCT CONCEPT atlas, one landscape 4:3 image in an EXACT 3-column 2-row equal cell layout. Input1 authoritative selected MOVERNO shoe. Input2 exact gate emblem only. Input3 exact wordmark only. Do NOT redesign shoe. Preserve: Dark black/graphite low elongated web-wrap runner. Open black mesh entirely crossed by MANY long gray and black flat woven tapes, diagonally and across forefoot and beneath bottom edges. One firm black diagonal side strip with a thin muted brass edge. Dark translucent segmented low sole, prominent extended rear pod. Tiny gate on square gray tab at heel loop. Preserve entire deliberate wrapping system, no simplifying into standard laces or free spaghetti cords. Top row left-to-right: OUTER lateral profile, INNER medial profile, FRONT straight-on. Bottom row: REAR straight-on, TOP-DOWN with toe toward bottom, OUTSOLE bottom with toe toward top. Six full shoes, one per cell, entirely contained, adequate breathing space, gray neutral seamless background consistent across cells, soft catalog light. Every view same shoe geometry and sole volume. Preserve existing exterior markings and pattern. Add restrained small MOVERNO lettering to tongue uppermost patch or loop and a small gate to rear heel center only where anatomically appropriate. Gate: two independent opposing upright curved blades, straight outer vertical edges, visible OPEN vertical center slit, not X or butterfly. New outsole is conceptual continuation of original visible rim and segments in dark translucent charcoal, with small molded MOVERNO in a recessed midfoot island. Keep text legible spelled M-O-V-E-R-N-O, no extra words, no label headings, no diagram or arrows, no new side logos or extra hardware, no colored accents beyond source. Do not paint lettering over existing cage or wrap straps. High quality photorealistic concept. NOT a techpack/measurement drawing.
QC PRIORITY: Do not add any logo, plaque, tab or badge to the TOE. Every toe must exactly match the unbranded toe of the original. MOVERNO is spelled with exactly 7 letters M O V E R N O. Prefer a small horizontal tongue label rather than vertical letters on a pull loop. Use the same tongue-label construction in FRONT and TOP views. Side motifs must not migrate to the toe. Six panels must have equal columns and equal rows, enough margin to show the entire shoes.
